subject: USB Wi-Fi peers available for Fx0 hardware qualification
status: Read-only capability inventory; not a phone functional test
host_network_constraint: Built-in wlo1 is the host connection; no network configuration, radio state, connection profiles, DNS or routes changed.
next_tests: Use separate USB adapters when AP and client roles are needed concurrently. Neither device advertises concurrent hardware interface combinations.
Phone hotspot: use a USB adapter as the associated client; verify DHCP, bidirectional traffic, forwarding, reconnect and suspend. The existing phone evidence requires PMF disabled.

Phone client: use the dual-band USB adapter as a controlled AP to test both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz. Bind any future profiles to that USB interface, disable autoconnect, default routes and automatic DNS changes.
Confirm capabilities by actual AP/client association before treating the host lab setup as qualified.
